stem: A rectangular photo is 6 inches long and 4 inches wide. A larger print is made by increasing both the length and the width of the photo by \(x\) inches. The area of the larger print is twice the area of the original photo. What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: The original area is \(6 \cdot 4 = 24\) square inches, so the larger print has area \(48\).
Factor: \((x + 12)(x - 2) = 0\). A length increase is positive, so \(x = 2\).
verify:
x = symbols('x', positive=True)
sol = solve(Eq((6 + x)*(4 + x), 2*6*4), x)
assert sol == [2]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
